scientific_boundary: The twelve-symbol algebra and closure counterexamples are exact. The 194-edge census is finite and does not prove closure of a richer transducer, the all-depth adjacent-shadow inclusion, phase-complexity divergence, exclusion of eventual period two, or Rule 30 center nonperiodicity.

theorem.fiber_formula: M(q) is the OR of the four fixed child masks indexed by the exact candidate-parent mask P(q).
theorem.six_state_no_go: The fiber pair 1011/1111 with shared digit 2 has both a safe successor 1111/1111 and an unsafe successor 1111/1100.
theorem.signature_alphabet: Digit-2 predecessor membership forces digit-3 membership, leaving exactly twelve universal parent/fiber signatures.
theorem.signature_nondeterminism: The source signature 1000/0011 with digit 0 has at least three exact successor signatures: 0010/1100, 1110/1111, and 0000/0000.
